name: Portal Market-Data Sourcing Strategy (YCharts vs Bloomberg-PKL vs SmartX)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-20 (CEO interview with 0.1.0_DS_MarketIntelligence + the ycharts.com.har 92MB capture). Goal: determine, surface by surface, which portal market-data surfaces currently fed by the manual Bloomberg pkl yang-pipeline could instead be sourced by a daily automated YCharts pull, and which must remain manual Bloomberg pkl -- the end-state is an explicit hybrid. Also evaluates whether model-portfolio performance is better sourced from YCharts /model_portfolios/*, the yang model.pkl, or the SmartX backend. Operational model: replicate the Orion/Eclipse manual-credential-refresh + Secrets-Manager pattern, adapted for YCharts (CTO HAR finding, independently corroborated by DS 0.1.0: YCharts is a Django session-cookie web app behind AWS WAF -- NOT a JWT-bearer API; the operational pattern transfers, the credential type does not). This is a feasibility + audit project: v0.2 charters five workstreams; the implementation PRD v0.3 is authored by the CTO from the audit synthesis (WS-5 / TO-5). v0.2 authorizes NO code/Terraform/Lambda/portal change. Project code MDSRC = Market Data SouRCing (DS 0.1.0 mnemonic), prefixed with the YALP macro per the {MACRO}_{6CHAR} convention.
phase: Phase 0 -- AUDIT CHARTER. PRD v0.2 SHIPPED 2026-05-20 (1.0.0_SA_CTO). v0.2 amendment (Andrew-direct, pre-dispatch): the audit is re-parallelized across THREE DS by domain because it is too much for one DS. Five workstreams: WS-1 External Market Data domain audit (0.1.0_DS_MarketIntelligence -- indices/securities/macro + Market Overview/Valuation/Correlation/Macro pages); WS-2 Portfolio Analytics domain audit (0.2.0_DS -- metrics/factor/attribution + Factor Tilts/Positioning/CMA/MP-analytics); WS-3 Client-Based/Facing Data domain audit (0.4.0_DS_ClientPlatform -- model-portfolio performance sourcing + SmartX backend + client-tied surfaces, coordinates MDPF_ASSETS); WS-4 YCharts operational-pattern declaration from the Orion/Eclipse baseline (0.7.0_AE_CloudOps); WS-5 CTO synthesis -> migration decision matrix + integration architecture -> PRD v0.3 (gated on WS-1..4). v0.1 (single-DS WS-A backend + AE 0.5.0 WS-B surface audit + WS-D SmartX) superseded pre-dispatch; AE 0.5.0 -> named yang-pipeline-mechanism consult. CTO HAR reconnaissance complete + corroborated by DS 0.1.0's recon brief docs/briefs/ycharts-bloomberg-portal-data-sourcing-audit-20260520.md (3987616d8). Awaiting COO re-decomposition + Andrew GO for Phase 0 dispatch.
blocking: None -- PRD v0.2 shipped, handed to COO for TO-1..5 re-decomposition (v0.1 decomposition halted pre-commit). Phase 0 TO-1..4 dispatch on Andrew GO.
